ios.desc:
One AI can be wrong. Five flagship AIs pressure-testing each other? Now you're getting somewhere.

Stop gambling on single-source answers for decisions that matter. When the stakes are high, you need more than one perspective. You need a debate that moves you forward.

THE PROBLEM WITH ASKING ONE AI
You ask ChatGPT a question. You get an answer. It sounds confident. But is it right?

Every AI has blind spots. Biases baked into training data. Knowledge gaps. Hallucinations dressed up as facts. And when you're making a hiring decision, evaluating a contract, or betting your quarter on a strategy, "probably right" isn't good enough.

THE PINGPONG DIFFERENCE
Ask once. Get five AI-expert perspectives, each one challenging the last.

1. You ask your question (type, speak, or attach files)
2. Grok deconstructs to first principles
3. Perplexity pulls the sources
4. ChatGPT expands the possibilities
5. Gemini stress-tests the logic
6. Claude distills the final answer

What you get isn't five separate answers. It's a structured debate where weak arguments get exposed, blind spots get filled, and the strongest thinking rises to the top.

WHO IT'S FOR
→ Professionals making high-stakes decisions
→ Founders validating strategy before committing resources
→ Investors stress-testing assumptions in pitch decks
→ Lawyers seeking holes in their own arguments
→ Product managers resolving conflicting stakeholder input
→ Complex relationship issues, especially when you're feeling emotional
→ Anyone tired of wondering "but what if this AI is wrong?"

WHAT HAPPENS IN PRACTICE
"Should I accept this job offer?" becomes a five-perspective analysis of compensation benchmarks, career trajectory, company stability, negotiation leverage, and opportunity cost, with each AI pointing out what the previous one missed.

"Is this contract fair?" gets examined for hidden liabilities, missing clauses, industry-standard terms, and red flags that a single AI might gloss over.

The debate format catches errors. It surfaces nuance. It gives you the confidence to act.

FEATURES
• 5 Flagship Models — always updated to the latest versions of Grok, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, all with web search capabilities
• Pro Mode: Extended thinking
• Fast Mode: Quick responses for everyday queries
• Attach images, PDFs, spreadsheets, code, documents
• Drag-and-drop to reorder models
• Continue conversations with any individual model
• Offline history and beautiful dark mode
• Email alerts when pingp
